---
name: Community recipe
about: Share a meal or drink from your own kitchen, including cold-season recipes.
---

## Dish and cooking style

What do you call this meal or drink? Which tradition, region or technique would you file it under? A new style is welcome.

## Ingredients and servings

Give amounts, yield and preparation time. Note any swaps you have actually cooked.

## Method

Describe the steps and the signs that tell the cook when it is ready.

## Credit or story

Share where you learned the recipe or how you adapted it. If you worked from a published recipe, link to the cook and say what you changed. Use your own wording and only include names you have permission to publish.

## Cold-season collection (optional)

Should this go in the cold-season collection? Tell us one thing a cook would want to know, such as how to get a softer texture or make a serving with fewer dishes to wash.

## Research (optional)

If you make a health claim, link the human research or food composition record and say what was measured. For a cold study, explain which symptom changed, over what time, and how the studied preparation compares with yours. A family recipe needs no health claim.
